title: Bandpass IIR Filter Design
text: Design bandpass IIR filter with tunable filter specifications, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Design method} sets Filter design method; {Smooth tuned filter parameters}, {Smoothing factor}, {Specify filter order from input port} sets the flag to specify filter order from input, {Filter order (must be even)}, {Filter maximum order (must be even)} sets the maximum order of filter, {Design has scale values} sets the if filter has scale values for each, {Specify first 3-dB cutoff frequency from input port} sets the flag to specify first 3-dB cutoff frequency from input, {First 3-dB cutoff frequency}, {Specify second 3-dB cutoff frequency from input port} sets the flag to specify second 3-dB cutoff frequency from input, {Second 3-dB cutoff frequency}, {Specify the passband ripple from input port} sets the flag to specify passband ripple from input, {Passband ripple (dB)} sets the passband ripple in dB, {Specify the stopband attenuation from input port} sets the flag to specify stopband attenuation from input, {Stopband attenuation (dB)} sets the stopband attenuation in dB, {Sample time}, {Filter cascade sections form} sets the form of filter cascade sections Fourth-order, {Output data type} sets the data type of filter and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
